lessons: OutLayer's testnet flipped between 20 s and 170 s answers all afternoon; a check on chain gets about 2 minutes, so about half the checks came back empty

a to_evm move of USDC is counted as arrived only while the USDC sits at the address (80% of what was sent). The main session told the user to skip 'Check now' and repay Aave at once; the USDC was spent before a check saw it, so move:2 stays listed until its deadline and is then dropped with forget_transfer ('Drop this move').
